items.title: 8.5.3 How to Protect Your Intellectual Property

source_refs.note: Topic 8.5.3 (PDF 203-204, printed 200-201). The book says copyrights are protected by registering them; the note that copyright arises automatically is general knowledge, flagged. MCQ 10 is answered (c); the key gives (b). Recorded.

items: Patents: apply for a patent through the Intellectual Property Organization of Pakistan (IPO Pakistan).
Trademarks: register your brand name, logo or slogan so others cannot use it.
Copyrights: protect creative works by registering them with the appropriate authority.
Trade secrets: keep valuable business information confidential and use legal agreements to protect it.
